She is said to have been a wealthy young woman who converted to Christianity and was persecuted for her faith. historical_references.reference: Another tradition associates Reginella with the town of Termini Imerese in Sicily. According to this account, she was a beautiful young woman who converted to Christianity in the 5th century AD during the reign of Emperor Zeno. She was denounced to the authorities for her faith and subjected to various tortures, including having her limbs torn apart and being exposed to the elements. She is said to have miraculously survived these ordeals, but was eventually put to death.
